description: Responsive Layout System - Make the sidebar collapsible with hamburger menu on mobile, add bottom navigation bar for mobile, convert Layout to responsive with proper breakpoints, and ensure touch-friendly tap targets (min 44px).
steps: Create src/hooks/useMediaQuery.js - a custom hook that listens for a media query match (e.g., '(max-width: 768px)') and returns boolean. Also create src/hooks/useOnlineStatus.js that tracks navigator.onLine and returns { isOnline }.

Refactor src/components/layout/Layout.jsx: Add state for sidebar open/closed (default closed on mobile, open on desktop). Use useMediaQuery('(max-width: 768px)') to determine isMobile. On mobile: show hamburger button in header area, render sidebar as an overlay (fixed, z-50) with backdrop, remove the fixed ml-[220px] and use ml-0 on mobile. On desktop: keep existing behavior with ml-[220px]. Pass sidebarOpen/setSidebarOpen and isMobile as props or context.

Refactor src/components/layout/Sidebar.jsx: Accept props for isOpen, onClose, and isMobile. On mobile, render as a slide-in panel (translate-x based on isOpen) with a close button and backdrop click-to-close. Keep the existing desktop appearance. Add transition-transform duration-300 for smooth animation. Ensure all nav items have min-h-[44px] for touch targets.

Create src/components/layout/MobileBottomNav.jsx: A fixed bottom navigation bar (h-16, z-40) shown only on mobile (md:hidden). Include 5 key nav items: Dashboard (/), Nurses (/nurses), Placements (/placements), Notifications (/notifications), and a 'More' button that opens the full sidebar. Use NavLink for active state styling. Icons from lucide-react (LayoutDashboard, Users, Briefcase, Bell, Menu). Active item gets propela-purple color.

Update src/components/layout/Header.jsx: On mobile, add a hamburger menu button (Menu icon from lucide-react) on the left side that triggers sidebar open. Accept onToggleSidebar prop. Make the header height responsive - keep h-14 but adjust padding for mobile (px-4 on mobile vs px-6 on desktop).

Add pb-20 to the main content area on mobile (to account for bottom nav bar height) in Layout.jsx. Add responsive padding to the main content: p-4 on mobile, p-8 on desktop (change the existing p-8 to p-4 md:p-8).
acceptance_criteria: On screens <= 768px, sidebar is hidden by default and accessible via hamburger menu
Hamburger menu icon is visible in the header on mobile viewports
Sidebar slides in from left with smooth animation when opened on mobile
Clicking backdrop or close button closes the mobile sidebar
Bottom navigation bar is visible on mobile with 5 quick-access items
All navigation items have minimum 44px touch target height
On desktop (>768px), layout is unchanged from previous behavior (fixed sidebar at 220px)
npm run build succeeds without errors
findings: Used useSyncExternalStore for useMediaQuery hook to comply with React 19 strict lint rules (no setState in effects, no ref access during render). Used a null-based sidebarOverride pattern instead of useEffect+setState for sidebar state sync on viewport changes. All pre-existing lint errors in design-reference/ and other files are unrelated to this feature.
